title: Tummy Tuck Scar: Where It Sits and How It Fades
meta_description: A full tummy tuck scar usually runs hip bone to hip bone, placed low so underwear can cover it. Where it sits by type and how it fades over a year or more.
excerpt: A full tummy tuck scar usually runs from hip bone to hip bone, placed low so underwear or swimsuit bottoms can cover it. Here is where it sits for each type, how it fades, and what the evidence does and doesn't show on silicone and scar creams.
quick_answer:
Where is a tummy tuck scar, and does it fade?

A full tummy tuck scar usually runs hip bone to hip bone, just above the pubic area, often with a scar around the belly button (Cleveland Clinic). It is placed low so underwear or swimsuit bottoms can cover it (Jonathan Weiler, MD, on the ASPS website) and turns thinner and lighter at around 12 to 18 months (Cindy Wu, MD).

Where the scar sits, by type

Mini: short and low, 3 to 6 inches
Full: hip bone to hip bone, often with a scar around the belly button
Extended: longer and often higher, around the flanks
Fleur-de-lis: across the abdomen, plus a vertical scar

Sources: Cleveland Clinic; The Aesthetic Society; Samir Rao, MD

Protecting a new scar from the sun

Stay out of the sun as the wound heals
Cover the scar with clothing when you can
Sunscreen with an SPF of 30 for 12 to 18 months if you have to be in the sun

sources.title: Tummy Tuck Scar (last updated 08/16/2022)
quotes: Full tummy tuck: The scar for a standard tummy tuck usually spans your abdomen, from hip bone to hip bone, just above your pubic area. You may also have a scar around your belly button.
It’s about the length of a C-section scar (between 3 inches and 6 inches).
A second vertical scar runs from your lower breastbone to your pubic bone.
The scar is usually thin. It may be raised, recessed, slightly pink or lighter than the surrounding skin.
You can’t completely prevent a tummy tuck scar.
Small or fine tummy tuck scars may fade completely after about a year. However, most people will still have a visible scar.
Your surgeon will likely use special glue, tape or bandages on your incision. These surgical dressings can reduce scarring by holding the skin of the incision together and keeping it moist.
Avoid heavy lifting, strenuous exercise, sexual activity and stretching until your provider says it’s safe to do these activities (usually four to eight weeks after the procedure).
Quitting smoking several months before your procedure can help your surgical wound heal.
Some corticosteroids can slow wound healing.
Some conditions, such as diabetes, can complicate wound healing.
About 2 to 3 weeks after your surgery, you may consider scar massage.

Ultraviolet radiation can make your scar discolored or change its texture, making it thicker. For 12 to 18 months after your tummy tuck, wear sunscreen with an SPF (sun protection factor) of 30 if you have to be in the sun.
Steroid injections may help reduce the appearance of a thick, raised or red tummy tuck scar. Most providers reserve these injections for abnormal scarring
Laser skin resurfacing may reduce the appearance of a tummy tuck scar. This is another treatment usually reserved for abnormal scaring.

During scar revision, a surgeon cuts the scar out of your skin and then closes the wound with stitches. Most people need to wait 12 to 18 months after their tummy tuck for scar revision surgery. This is a time when the scar is about as good as it is going to get
Laser skin resurfacing can cause swelling, blistering and skin redness. Surgical scar revision may cause infection, bleeding or additional scarring.
Contact your healthcare provider if you notice your incision is:
Infected (pus or foul-smelling drainage coming from the wound).

sources.title: Tummy Tuck - Incisions and Scars
quotes: The incision for a full abdominoplasty usually runs from hip bone to hip bone, and may be in a V-cut or U-cut shape, so that the scar can be hidden in a bikini. Your surgeon will determine the shape and length of the incision based on your preferences and the amount of correction you need.
The length of the mini-tummy tuck incision and scarring can range from a few inches to the entire span of your abdomen.
There are no incisions around the navel.
With a high lateral tension abdominoplasty, scars are longer and often higher than scars in more traditional tummy tucks and mini-tummy tucks.

Your incision healing and resulting scars will depend on the surgical technique, the steps you take to prevent infection (nutrition, not smoking, hydrating), and any underlying medical conditions or genetic tendencies.

quotes: A total of 34 trials were included in this study. Only a limited number of studies supported the effectiveness of onion extract, vitamin E, trolamine, and microporous tape products.

sources.title: The Role of Topical Vitamin E in Scar Management: A Systematic Review (Tanaydin V and colleagues, 2016, PMID 26977069)
quotes: Only six studies met the inclusion criteria. Of these six included studies, three reported a significant improvement in the cosmetic appearance of scars when using vitamin E

The other three selected studies showed no significant improvement in scar appearance when using topical vitamin E as monotherapy. Two of the six included studies reported adverse events of vitamin E application: contact dermatitis and increased incidence of itching and rash.
We conclude that there is not yet sufficient evidence that monotherapy with topical vitamin E has a significant beneficial effect on scar appearance to justify its widespread use.

notes: Retargeted from 'Tummy Tuck Scars Miami: What to Expect & Fade Fast' under issue #357, reversing the fold in the 2026-10-05 plan (9,900 US searches a month, 78 impressions in 90 days). Written fresh for readers deciding. Removed: Miami targeting in title, headings and body; the double board-certified, accredited-facility and Luxury lines; the invented patient quote ('Maria'); phone numbers; financing partners and terms; the unsourced week-by-week colour stages; SPF 50+, reapply every 2 hours, shade 10 to 4; silicone from week 3 for 3 to 12 months; massage at week 4 for 5 to 10 minutes; garment 6 to 8 weeks; 'accelerates fading'; the 4% major complication line. Figures follow tummy-tuck.facts.ts where it covers them; figures it does not declare have their own quotes here: 3 months to 2 years (The Aesthetic Society aftercare), 2 to 3 weeks for massage, 12 to 18 months for revision (Cleveland Clinic), 3 to 6 months of silicone (Michelle Roughton, MD, in an ASPS website article), 12 hours a day for 3 to 4 months and a 6-month limit (Commander 2016), and the trial counts in the reviews. Two reviews on silicone disagree, and the post says so: Cochrane 2013 finds weak evidence from poor-quality trials, Tran 2020 is more positive. The line 'no controlled trial of silicone on tummy tuck scars' rests on PubMed searches on 2026-11-03: abdominoplasty silicone (22 results), abdominoplasty scar topical (9), abdominoplasty scar silicone randomized (0), tummy tuck scar silicone (0); titles read, none is a controlled silicone trial (31565401 is a gene-expression case series). Massage: the fact-check of 4 Nov found Shin and Bordeaux 2012 (22093081), which covers surgical scars and is now cited; the other reviews found are on burn scars (28669442, 35758338, 38072714). Weight limits from the ASPS article (ten pounds) are left out on purpose: the facts file carries no weight limit. Nothing says what the practice uses or offers for scar care, lasers or revision: owner questions, stated as questions to ask. The extended mini line comes from the practice's price sheet via the facts file, with no price. No price appears anywhere; the post links #pricing. Deviation from the plan's card: the C-section and mini vs full posts (N2, N3) are not linked because they ship in Batch 3 and this post ships in Batch 1, so a link would 404 until then; the page's #which-tummy-tuck and #candidate carry those readers. Add both links when Batch 3 goes live. The live FAQs on Miami sun, vitamins C and E, IPL and hyperpigmentation were dropped as unsourced or Miami-targeted; healing and fading questions are answered in the body and FAQ.
